scope: Every acquisition restriction row on main: 152 listing download holds and 5 managed acquisition holds (16 typed decisions).
method: Upstream facts were read without credentials: git ls-remote, a tags-only tree-less fetch and a depth-1 blobless clone (tree listing only) for readability, tag names and dates, the last commit date and licence file names; raw.githubusercontent.com for licence texts (SPDX id inferred from the text); web fetches of repository and release pages for the rows that needed them. Tag dates are git dates unless a release publish date is stated.

proposed_reconsider_when.note: Proposed values for a follow-up data change; none is authored on main today. reviewed-successor-release needs a release or artifact scope to have a reviewed baseline; a hold scoped only by platform evaluates it as unknown, so pair it with a scoped permit or use owner-review.
